audit_metadata.title: External Dataset Source Audit and Local Integrity Verification
inspection_guarantees: Zero gated repositories accessed or bypassed
Zero authentication credentials or API tokens used
Zero candidate sentences created or copied
Zero modifications to existing unified or custom datasets

ai4bharat_indiclid.access_status: Public direct access (GitHub release zips and Hugging Face dataset card)

metadata_observed.paper: Bhasha-Abhijnaanam: Native-script and romanized Language Identification for 22 Indic languages (arXiv:2305.15814)

licence_observed.code_and_models: MIT License (covers repo code and trained models)
licence_observed.training_archives: Aggregated from crawled web corpora (IndicCorp, Dakshina, IndicXlit, Samanantar); separate open research terms apply; MIT does not automatically cover underlying training archives
licence_observed.bhasha_abhijnaanam_benchmark: CC0-1.0 (Declared on dataset card for manually collected data)

ai4bharat_indiclid.language_and_script: 22 Indic languages in native scripts and Romanized transliteration; native Telugu (Telugu script), Roman Telugu (Latin script), Hindi (Devanagari and Latin)
ai4bharat_indiclid.sample_inspection_method: Public repository README, release manifests, and Hugging Face dataset card metadata inspection (zero rows downloaded to avoid benchmark contamination)

suitability_classifications.category_A_native_telugu: REFERENCE ONLY (Bhasha-Abhijnaanam is an evaluation benchmark; must NOT be used for candidate training curation to avoid leakage. Training data is FastText sentence-level)
suitability_classifications.category_B_english_telugu: NOT SUITABLE (Sentence-level monolingual/transliterated buckets; no token-level code-mixing)

limitations: Data is sentence-level only (FastText format '__label__<code_script> <sentence>') without token-level LID boundaries.
Bhasha-Abhijnaanam test set must remain strictly an external out-of-distribution evaluation benchmark; copying sentences into candidate_sentences.jsonl is barred.

sudeshna84_bht25.source_name: BHT25: Bengali-Hindi-Telugu Parallel Corpus for Literary Machine Translation
sudeshna84_bht25.access_status: Public direct access (Apache Parquet on Hugging Face; no gating)

metadata_observed.publisher: Sudeshna Sani, Suryakanth V. Gangashetty, Samudravijaya K, Anik Nandi, Aruna Priya, Vineeth Kumar, Akhilesh Kumar Dubey (Data in Brief 2026)

reported_quality.semantic_alignment_accuracy: 75.8% (sample-based, not individual verification of all 27,149 rows)
reported_quality.domain_bias: Literary domain (Rabindranath Tagore and Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay)

licence_observed.attribution_obligations: Must cite Sani et al. (Data in Brief 2026), provide link to CC BY 4.0, and indicate if changes were made.

sudeshna84_bht25.language_and_script: Bengali (Bengali script), Hindi (Devanagari script), Telugu (Telugu script)
sudeshna84_bht25.sample_inspection_method: Public Hugging Face datasets-server REST API streaming (inspected 20 sample triplets without downloading full dataset)

suitability_classifications.category_A_native_telugu: SUITABLE WITH CONDITIONS (Telugu text is human-translated under CC BY 4.0; requires 100% human review of all selected sentences for length, OCR, and alignment)
suitability_classifications.category_B_english_telugu: NOT SUITABLE (Contains no English text; is not code-mixed)
suitability_classifications.category_C_hindi_telugu: REFERENCE ONLY (Parallel sentences; must NOT be concatenated to manufacture artificial code-mixing)

limitations: Parallel corpus, NOT a code-mixed dataset. Combining Hindi and Telugu parallel sentences is strictly forbidden by project guidelines.
Literary domain bias; lacks conversational and modern digital colloquial phrasing.
5.8% suboptimal alignment rate requires human spot-checking when sampling.

ltrc_hindi_telugu.access_status: Gated access (Requires agreement to share account information with repository authors; NOT bypassed)

metadata_observed.publication_corpus_descriptions: Publication describes a 700K qualitative corpus and a 535K developed corpus across domains: Chemistry, Law, News, Healthcare, Education, Open education books
metadata_observed.publisher: Language Technologies Research Centre (LTRC), IIIT Hyderabad

licence_observed.gated_condition: Access requires agreement to share account details with authors.

ltrc_hindi_telugu.sample_inspection_method: Public Hugging Face repository metadata inspection only (zero records fetched; no gate agreement submitted)

suitability_classifications.category_A_native_telugu: REFERENCE ONLY (Gated access; BHT25 provides sufficient ungated CC BY 4.0 native Telugu)
suitability_classifications.category_C_hindi_telugu: REFERENCE ONLY (Parallel sentences; cannot be combined to manufacture code-mixing)

limitations: Gated access requires agreement to share user account info; strictly barred from automated download by project rules.

mozilla_telugu_text.access_status: Public catalog access on Mozilla Data Collective

metadata_observed.authorship: Four authors across multiple writing domains (news, blogs, literature, spiritual essays)

licence_observed.licence: Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial Share Alike 4.0 International (CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0)
licence_observed.share_alike_warning: Viral copyleft: Any derivative dataset publicly distributed must be licensed under the identical CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 license.

mozilla_telugu_text.sample_inspection_method: Mozilla Data Collective metadata and dataset card inspection (no bulk file download)

suitability_classifications.category_A_native_telugu: SUITABLE WITH CONDITIONS (High-quality native Telugu, but derivative dataset must comply with CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 Share-Alike terms if redistributed)

limitations: Share-Alike clause forces downstream works under CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0.
Requires institutional/faculty review before redistributing derived datasets.

mozilla_common_voice_telugu.access_status: Public catalog access on Mozilla Data Collective

metadata_observed.rehosting_clause: The dataset page explicitly prohibits rehosting or resharing the dataset.

licence_observed.rehosting_restriction: Explicit terms prohibit rehosting or resharing the corpus.

mozilla_common_voice_telugu.sample_inspection_method: Dataset card metadata inspection only (zero sentences copied into project)

suitability_classifications.category_A_native_telugu: REFERENCE ONLY (Use as external reference only until redistribution condition is clarified; do not copy sentences into candidate dataset)

limitations: Rehosting/resharing prohibition contradicts typical CC0-1.0 terms; redistribution condition is legally ambiguous.
High proportion of unvalidated sentences (19,700 out of 20,072).

ai4bharat_indiccorp_telugu.access_status: Public download links from AI4Bharat servers

metadata_observed.format: One sentence per line, plain text
metadata_observed.provenance: Scraped from diverse web sources and news portals

licence_observed.licence: No clear data licence found on public page
licence_observed.note: Web-scraped corpus without an explicit open-source data license or copyright declaration on the corpora index page.

ai4bharat_indiccorp_telugu.sample_inspection_method: Public index metadata inspection (no data downloaded)

suitability_classifications.category_A_native_telugu: LICENCE UNCLEAR (Massive sentence volume, but unclear data licensing makes it unsuitable for redistribution without legal clarification)

limitations: Lack of clear licensing terms poses redistribution risks.
Classified strictly as LICENCE UNCLEAR per project mandate.

BHT25.rationale: CC BY 4.0; 27,149 triplets (sample validation 75.8%); requires 100% human review; parallel sentences must NOT be concatenated.

Mozilla_Telugu_Text.rationale: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 requires downstream derivative redistribution to also carry Share-Alike license.

Mozilla_Common_Voice_Telugu.rationale: Page explicitly prohibits rehosting/resharing despite CC0 tag; use as reference only until clarified.

LTRC_Hindi_Telugu.rationale: Gated access requiring account agreement; not downloaded. Parallel corpus, not code-mixed.

AI4Bharat_IndicLID_Training.rationale: Sentence-level FastText format; underlying web crawl licensing unclear; no token boundaries.

AI4Bharat_Bhasha_Abhijnaanam.rationale: Evaluation benchmark test set. Barred from candidate/training curation to prevent leakage.

AI4Bharat_IndicCorp_Telugu.rationale: Web-scraped corpus with no clear data license declared on public page.

Human_Authored_Elicitation.rationale: Token-level native Telugu code-mixed sentences are completely absent from public corpora.
